moments.hv.title: {n} chests at once
moments.sm.m7: A whole week of light. Seven lanterns, one for each day. Your room’s flame frame is now bronze
moments.sm.m30: A month of light. Your room’s flame frame is now silver
moments.sm.m100: A hundred days. A new dawn. Your room’s flame frame is now gold
moments.sm.m365: A whole year of light, alhamdulillah. A crescent now crowns your room’s flame
moments.lv.sub: Your character gathers more light as it grows
moments.lv.b1: Your character now stands on a glow of light
moments.lv.b2: A soft halo of light now surrounds your character
moments.lv.b3: Two lights now circle your character
moments.lv.b4: Your character now shines at its edges
moments.lv.b5: Rays of light now rise behind your character
moments.lv.b6: Radiant: your character is all gold
